card.hint.counterCore.web: Prepare counter until next player turn. A covered hit returns half its incoming damage (more with stance advantage) plus Poise damage; card support effects resolve when played.

combat.protectionHelp.barrier.web: Barrier is blue, the layer above Ward. Magic sources and cards that add Ward refill Ward first and the rest becomes Barrier; other sources add Barrier directly. Barrier soaks magic hits completely before Ward and lasts until the start of its owner's next turn.

combat.protectionHelp.block.web: Absorbs attack damage. Expires at the start of the owner's turn unless an effect preserves it.

combat.protectionHelp.counter.web: Return half incoming damage and Poise

combat.protectionHelp.poise.web: Poise guards against physical hits. Full at the start of every fight, it absorbs each physical hit after Block (each hit still lets at least 1 damage through) and is spent by what it absorbs. When it breaks, a player pays 1 Stamina next turn; an enemy is interrupted. It does not regenerate unless a card, feat, class feature or relic restores it.

combat.protectionHelp.ward.web: Ward guards against magic. Full at the start of every fight, it absorbs each magic hit after Barrier (each hit still lets at least 1 damage through) and is spent by what it absorbs; a Ward break costs Stamina next turn. Block does not stop magic. It does not regenerate unless a card, feat, class feature or relic restores it.
